$comment: AWS Labs MCP servers for this repository. See docs/mcp/README.md.
Deliberately small. AWS's own guidance is that overlapping tools confuse
agents and reduce performance, and every server's tools occupy context in
every request. Five servers is roughly 40-60 tools; adding all 61 available
servers would be several hundred and would measurably degrade results.
The managed AWS MCP Server is NOT listed here on purpose -- install it as a
plugin instead (see the docs). Running it alongside aws-api-mcp-server or
aws-knowledge-mcp-server is the specific overlap AWS warns against.
